rule.statement: The court must consider the authenticity of documents before admitting them as evidence.
rule.supporting_quote: The court is required to consider whether admitting the document is obnoxious to the provisions governing admission of documents (mode of proof)[;] (b) Secondly, court is required to give its mind as to whether the impugned statement suggests any inference as to any fact in issue or relevant fact and if so, whether the statement is relevant under [S]ection 17 read with Section 21 of the Evidence Ordinance.
